text: hm. ok i dont know what to tell you with this one honestly. i restarted -> blank -> restarted -> blank -> restarted -> now it renders, and the knob is still showing through, as for the outliner being merged together, that also, is now back to normal. so i REALLY dont know what to tell you but the anomoly is a bit terrifying
resolution: The terrifying anomaly explained and instrumented: the door came back because this session restored Door_Wall_1 from git between the user's second and third restart — not self-healing. The knob-through-panel returning is the v1-doc legacy glass routing (req_3043), unchanged. The actual bug — host part ranges silently cleared mid-session so the next save persists a merged-parts doc — is heisenbug-shaped, so three tripwires now name the culprit at runtime: writeMeshDoc screams when saving fewer host ranges than parts metadata declares (cart-side, hot-reloaded LIVE into the running dev host); meshEditSetPartRanges logs an empty push clearing existing ranges; journalInstall logs a rangeless snapshot restore over a parted mesh (both host-side, ride the next rebuild). Commit 74c646e70. Next: the user can retry the export while watching the terminal — either it saves correctly (door heals to v2, window-only glass) or the scream names the exact path; the broken-resave backup is in the session scratchpad for comparison.
